verdict.rationale: Security-incident and breach response is a fair question for a law firm with an IP/IT/Data Protection practice, so the axis applies. However, the only data-related evidence describes advising on building and realizing IP/data assets and data-driven transactions. Nothing in the pack documents incident response, breach notification or regulator-facing work.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages
